name: Panasonic Toughpad FZ-G1 ATEX
statusNote: No longer sold. Panasonic's later Toughbook G2 and G3 have no ATEX version.
summary: The Panasonic Toughpad FZ-G1 ATEX is the hazardous-area version of a Panasonic rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2 under IECEx. Panasonic also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an Ex ic ec design running Windows 10 Pro. It has been discontinued.
imageAlt: Panasonic Toughpad FZ-G1 ATEX, front view

atex.marking: Ex ic ec IIC T3 Gc
atex.status: IECEx SUSPENDED 2026-03-06 at the ExCB's request after consulting Panasonic; certificate note: does not affect products made or installed before that date. ATEX status not found.

iecex.marking: Ex ic ec IIC T3 Gc

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ic ec)

safety.conditions: Portable equipment, not to be permanently installed in the hazardous area. External connections are forbidden in hazardous areas. Before use, check the display, jacks and port covers for damage and that covers are closed. Use only with the original leather case. Non-metallic parts must not be exposed to long-term UV or frequent temperature changes. Protect from mechanical impact; remove damaged equipment from the hazardous area. Do not rub plastic parts or the display. Follow the "Supplementary Instructions FZ-G1 series". The battery-loading power supply and optional accessories (except SIM, microSD and smart card) were excluded from the evaluation because they are not allowed in Zone 2.
safety.peripherals: Forbidden to use any external connection in hazardous areas. The configuration port (microSD or USB 2.0 or GPS) option "cannot be operated in ATEX environment" (spec sheet).
safety.certifiedAccessories: Only the original leather case (mandatory) and digitiser pen with tether are supplied. AC adapter CF-AA6413CG and port replicator are excluded from the evaluation (not for Zone 2). No Ex-rated keyboard, dock or scanner.

specs.ports: USB 3.0, optional USB 2.0 or microSD via configuration port, RJ-45 (LAN) , HDMI, headset, 24-pin port replicator connector
specs.storage: 256 GB SSD, microSD/SDXC via configuration port (not for ATEX use)
specs.exIp: IP54 (spec sheet; "tested by TÜV for ATEX certification")
specs.partNumbers: FZ-G1S****** (no WWAN, IIC) and FZ-G1T****** (with WWAN, IIB)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 10 Pro, x86; out of support)

variants.name: Marking versions
variants.description: The certification covers more than one version: Ex ic ec IIC T3 Gc (FZ-G1S, no WWAN); Ex ic ec IIB T3 Gc (FZ-G1T, with WWAN); ATEX: II 3G of the same, per spec sheet

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Microsoft ended Windows 10 Pro support on 14 October 2025. The maker doesn't state the edition; an LTSC edition would run longer.
